nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Inputs: current_task (object), triggering_comment_text (string), caller_user_id (string), personal_data (boolean), clickup_task_id (string). Returns: {task_comments, additional_context, sources_used, sources_filtered_out}.

nodes.name: Fetch Task Comments
nodes.notes: Step 0 (always): fetch last 30 comments. onError=continueRegularOutput.

nodes.name: Build Search Prompt
nodes.notes: Assembles query-extraction prompt for Haiku. Uses task name+description (always, up to 1200 chars) plus triggering comment when present. Always fires — model returns queries:[] when nothing to search.

nodes.name: Extract Queries
nodes.notes: Haiku call via Invoke Model. triggered_by=search_step (needs migration 009). onError=continueErrorOutput -> alert -> Build Output.

nodes.name: Alert Extract Failed
nodes.notes: WARN when query extraction fails.

value.message: Search (v1): wyodrębnianie zapytań przez model nie powiodło się — zwrócono tylko komentarze zadania.

nodes.name: Parse Queries
nodes.notes: Parse model JSON -> queries[]. Empty array on parse failure.

nodes.name: Has Queries
nodes.notes: False -> Build Output (model found nothing to search for).

nodes.name: Expand Queries
nodes.notes: Expand queries array to multiple items for SplitInBatches.

nodes.name: Query Loop
nodes.notes: Loop output -> Search Tasks -> back. Done -> Merge Results.

nodes.name: Search Tasks
nodes.notes: Search ClickUp tasks. onError=continueRegularOutput: failed search = empty tasks array.

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.notes: Deduplicate search results from all query loop iterations.

nodes.name: Has Candidates
nodes.notes: False -> Build Output (no results found).

nodes.name: Expand Spaces
nodes.notes: Expand space_ids to individual items for Space Loop.

nodes.name: Space Loop
nodes.notes: Loop over space_ids. Loop -> Check Space Member -> back. Done -> Layer B Filter.

nodes.name: Check Space Member
nodes.notes: Fetch space members for Layer B. onError=continueRegularOutput: empty members = fail-closed (caller excluded).

nodes.name: Layer B Filter
nodes.notes: Layer B (ADR-004): keep only artifacts in spaces where caller_user_id is a member. Matches Expand Spaces items (by order) to membership responses. Fail-closed. Cap: 8 artifacts.

nodes.name: Has Accessible
nodes.notes: False -> Build Output (all filtered by Layer B).

nodes.name: Expand Artifacts
nodes.notes: Expand accessible artifacts to individual items for Artifact Loop.

nodes.name: Artifact Loop
nodes.notes: Loop over accessible artifacts (up to 8). Loop -> Read Task -> back. Done -> Build Output.

nodes.name: Read Task
nodes.notes: Read full task content. onError=continueRegularOutput: failed reads return empty and loop continues.

nodes.name: Build Output
nodes.notes: Assemble final output. Uses node references with try/catch so all convergence paths work.

nodes.name: Has Condense Content
nodes.notes: True -> selectively condense additional_context with Haiku (quality-based, not size-based). False -> pass through unchanged.

nodes.name: Build Condense Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds prompt for selective condense: keep technical specs verbatim, summarize repetitive/low-value content.

parameters.jsCode:
const wc = $('When Called').first().json;
const task = wc.current_task || {};
const prevOutput = $('Build Output').first().json;

const prompt =
  'Przejrzyj poniższe treści pobrane z ClickUp dla zadania. Twoim celem jest przygotowanie wersji jak najbardziej użytecznej dla modelu AI pracującego nad tym zadaniem.

' +
  'Zasady:
' +
  '- ZACHOWAJ DOSŁOWNIE: specyfikacje techniczne, dokładne wymagania, instrukcje krok po kroku, konkretne liczby, daty, decyzje, kod, unikalne informacje, konkretne wytyczne.
' +
  '- SKONDENSUJ w 1–3 zdaniach: powtarzające się komentarze, ogólne aktualizacje, wiadomości o niskiej gęstości informacji, powtórzenia, kwestie nieistotne dla sukcesu zadania.
' +
  '- Zachowaj nagłówki i strukturę.
' +
  '- Nie dodawaj własnych komentarzy ani wyjaśnień — tylko przetworzona treść.

' +
  '## Zadanie
' + (task.name || '') + '

' +
  (wc.triggering_comment_text ? '## Pytanie użytkownika
' + wc.triggering_comment_text + '

' : '') +
  '## Treść do przejrzenia
' + prevOutput.additional_context + '

' +
  'Zwróć przetworzoną treść. Bez wstępów ani dodatkowych wyjaśnień.';

return [{ json: { condense_prompt: prompt } }];

nodes.name: Call Condense
nodes.notes: Haiku call to selectively condense search results. onError=continueErrorOutput -> Alert Condense Failed -> Final Output with uncompressed content.

nodes.name: Alert Condense Failed
nodes.notes: WARN when condense Haiku call fails. Final Output falls back to uncompressed Build Output data.

value.message: Search (v1): kondensacja treści przez model nie powiodła się — przekazano nieskompresowaną treść.

nodes.name: Assemble Condensed
nodes.notes: Merge condensed additional_context back with task_comments, sources_used, sources_filtered_out from Build Output.

nodes.name: Final Output
nodes.notes: Terminal node. Prefers Assemble Condensed output; falls back to Build Output if condense path did not run.

nodes.name: Pick Threads
nodes.notes: Issue-2 reply reading: from the top 30 comments, pick those with reply_count>0 to fetch their thread replies. Emits one item {thread_ids:[...]}. Empty -> Has Threads? routes around the fetch.

nodes.name: Has Threads?
nodes.notes: True -> fetch replies. False (no threaded comments) -> straight to Build Search Prompt (avoids a 0-item stall in the per-item Fetch Replies).

nodes.name: Expand Threads
nodes.notes: Expand thread_ids to one item per comment id so Fetch Replies runs once per thread.

nodes.name: Fetch Replies
nodes.notes: GET /comment/{id}/reply per threaded comment. onError=continueRegularOutput: a failed thread fetch yields an error item (kept in order) so Collect Replies can skip it without breaking alignment. Best-effort enrichment (matches Fetch Task Comments).

nodes.name: Collect Replies
nodes.notes: Aligns Expand Threads inputs to Fetch Replies outputs by index (onError keeps 1 item per input). Returns replies_by_parent map keyed by top-level comment id. Build Output interleaves them.

nodes.name: Comments Fetch Failed?
nodes.notes: Side branch off Fetch Task Comments: true when the response has no comments array (HTTP failed under onError=continueRegularOutput). True -> WARN. Main path (Pick Threads) is independent and continues regardless.

nodes.name: Alert Comments Failed
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) when Fetch Task Comments returns no comments. Dead-end side branch + onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert failure never breaks the search.

value.message: Search (v1): pobranie komentarzy zadania nie powiodło się — kontekst budowany bez komentarzy i odpowiedzi w wątkach.

nodes.name: Reply Fetch Failed?
nodes.notes: Side branch off Collect Replies: true when one or more thread reply-fetches failed (reply_fetch_errors>0). True -> WARN. Main path (Build Search Prompt) is independent and continues regardless.

nodes.name: Alert Replies Failed
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) when one or more /comment/{id}/reply fetches fail. Dead-end side branch + onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert failure never breaks the search.

value.message: Search (v1): pobranie odpowiedzi w wątkach nie powiodło się dla części komentarzy — kontekst bez tych odpowiedzi.
